sections.title: Registration
paragraphs: Registration for the Global Gathering will be open at our registration desk outside the Kauri Ballroom from 3pm to 5pm on Monday 7 September, followed by 8am to 9am on Tuesday 8 September, just prior to Day 1’s programming commencing.

sections.title: Meals
paragraphs: Meals will be provided where possible, and stipends to cover the cost of your meals (where not possible) will be transferred to you.
We will reimburse delegates up to AUD$120 per day for the cost of your meals:
- Breakfast — up to AUD$25. Breakfast is included as part of your accommodation booking.
- Lunch — up to AUD$35. Morning tea, lunch and afternoon tea are provided every day of the Gathering.
- Dinner — up to AUD$60. We are planning to arrange a social event one evening that includes dinner.

sections.title: Getting to Cairns and to the Venue
paragraphs: Please ensure you download Uber prior to your arrival in Cairns so we can transfer you a voucher to use for your travel to and from the airport. All other travel for the week will be organised for you, with details to come.
Taxis and rideshare are the easiest way to get around Gimuy (Cairns).

sections.title: Visas and International Travel
paragraphs: Anyone travelling from outside Australia or New Zealand requires a visa to enter the country. Your application for a visa to enter Australia should already be underway.
Woven and Common Threads are not responsible for applying on your behalf, but will reimburse you for the cost of your application.
Instructions and resources to assist you with your application are here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LNCykvhupnTKQ0XGhBHFsOrhq6zLDEjb?usp=drive_link

sections.title: Travelling to Australia
paragraphs: Before you travel, please review the following:
- Review what you can bring into Australia: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/entering-australia/can-i-bring-it-in
- Learn more about visas, health and character requirements: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/entering-australia/can-i-go-to-australia
- Learn more about crossing our borders: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/entering-australia/crossing-the-border
Yellow Fever vaccination is mandatory if you are coming from a country with a high risk of transmission — likely for anyone travelling from countries in Africa, or Latin America and the Caribbean.
Several vaccinations are recommended, though not mandatory:
- Hepatitis A
- Polio
- COVID-19
- Influenza
- Hepatitis B
- Rabies (for long-term travellers or those in contact with animals)
- Japanese Encephalitis (depending on itinerary)
- Meningitis
- Chickenpox
- Shingles
- Tetanus, Diphtheria and Pertussis (Tdap)
- Measles, Mumps and Rubella (MMR)

Travel insurance is not required, but is highly recommended by the Australian Government and strongly encouraged by the Woven Project and Common Threads teams. Travel insurance is the responsibility of and at the expense of individual delegates to arrange. You should find a provider in your home country. Some visas may require proof of adequate insurance coverage.

sections.title: Accommodation
paragraphs: Accommodation is arranged by us; self-booking your accommodation is not necessary. You may need to provide a form of identification when you check in, but should not be asked to pay a bond.

Your accommodation includes breakfast at the hotel restaurant between 6:30am and 9:30am each day, noting our Gathering days start at 8:30am. Ensure you leave yourself plenty of time to enjoy breakfast and feel prepared for the day.

sections.title: Support Person
paragraphs: If you require a support person to travel with you, please reach out to the Woven team at info@thewovenproject.org as early as possible so arrangements can be made.
Interpreters and translators are provided for the Gathering and for subsidiary and social events, so travel for anyone attending solely to provide translation will not be approved.

sections.title: Weather and What to Pack
paragraphs: September in Gimuy (Cairns) is tropical dry season. Expect average temperatures between 23°C and 27°C (73°F to 80°F). The local forecast is here: https://www.bom.gov.au/qld/cairns/
We encourage delegates to pack:
- Appropriate clothes for the climate — see the local forecast above
- Insect repellent
- A reusable or refillable water bottle (glass is best)
- Hat, sunscreen, sunglasses and other forms of sun protection
- Closed-in shoes for cultural immersion activities
- A poncho or light waterproof clothing in case of rain
- A camera to take photos
- Spare cash for incidentals and souvenirs

sections.title: Illness Policy
paragraphs: The Global Gathering in Gimuy will bring together people from all over the world, working on a wide range of issues, from a diversity of perspectives. We are pleased to have Elders, young children, folks from remote or isolated communities and immunocompromised people joining us, and hope to ensure their safety and the safety of our communities.
As such, we recommend that all attendees who are feeling unwell stay home. If you are experiencing cold or flu-like symptoms or are otherwise unwell, we ask that you please do not attend the event.
Please do not attend or travel to the Global Gathering if:
- You have COVID-19 or test positive on a Rapid Antigen Test or a PCR test
- You are experiencing any cold or flu-like symptoms (for example cough, sore throat, runny nose, fever or headache) or are otherwise unwell
- You are a close contact of a confirmed COVID-19 case
If you are unable to attend, please let us know as soon as possible at info@thewovenproject.org
It is the responsibility of all delegates to arrange travel insurance for themselves to cover their travel to and from Australia, and whilst in town at Gimuy (Cairns) for the Gathering.

sections.title: Accessibility
paragraphs: The event venue and hotel are accessible spaces. If you require accessible accommodation, please let us know as soon as practical.
The Gathering will be supported by interpreters who will translate to and from English, Spanish, Russian, French and Portuguese.
Please reach out to Jay Knapp, Event Officer, if you have any questions or concerns about accessibility or your participation in the event.

sections.title: Wellbeing
paragraphs: This gathering covers land defence, dispossession and climate loss. These carry real weight, particularly for delegates with lived experience of them, and it is normal to need a moment away from the room.
Tiana Jakicevich is our Wellbeing and Grievance Coordinator and is available throughout the Gathering for a confidential conversation. You can also reach the team at info@thewovenproject.org.

sections.title: Money in Australia
paragraphs: - Most retailers have EFTPOS and credit card facilities. Visa and Mastercard are accepted everywhere; some smaller retailers may not accept American Express or Diners Club.
- Cash transactions made up less than 15% of all transactions in Australia as of 2025.

- You should bring some cash with you, within sensible limits. We are providing a stipend for meals and incidentals, but if you would like to self-arrange or self-fund any activities, ensure you bring enough. Anything over AUD$10,000 must be declared.
- Money exchange services at Australian airports attract a high fee, so consider exchanging money before you leave home.
- ATMs are widely available in Australia, and many supermarkets, petrol stations and retailers allow cash-out.
Learn more here: https://www.australia-backpackersguide.com/how-to-get-cash-australia/

sections.title: Allowances
paragraphs: Woven Project will cover the cost of:
- Accommodation in Cairns from Saturday 5 September to Friday 11 September, including breakfast
- Return economy flights from your city of departure to Cairns
- A stipend, to be confirmed, to cover meals, transfers and other out-of-pocket expenses

sections.title: Wifi, Smoking, ATMs, SIM Cards and Dress Code
paragraphs: Wifi is included as part of your accommodation and your attendance at the Gathering.
The Rydges Esplanade Resort Cairns is a non-smoking property. You will need to leave the property entirely if you wish to smoke.
The nearest ATMs are the atmx at Cairns Ampol: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Ed3dDDo9pDxdFVkH8 and the atmx at Cairns Night Markets: https://maps.app.goo.gl/oJk8nxfhzuNGZ8as6
We encourage you to purchase a SIM or eSIM card before you travel to be with us.

Please dress comfortably for the Gathering; we have no formal dress code. All we ask is that you dress to be comfortable and engage with the program. Some of the planned cultural immersion activities on Monday 7 September will require you to wear enclosed footwear.

sections.title: Photography and Consent
paragraphs: Photography and videography will take place across the gathering. Images and footage may be used to share the story of this event through our communications, publications, and social media. We are committed to capturing and sharing imagery respectfully and in the spirit of the gathering.
If you would prefer not to be photographed or filmed, please let us know at registration — your preference will be noted and honoured.
